#Requires -Version 5.1<#.SYNOPSIS    Launch Theme M1 -- Mixed Multi-Domain Orchestrator    Asks for config first, then starts portals + desktop apps, then runs orchestrator..USAGE    cd <this-folder>    .\launch_m1.ps1.ENV OVERRIDES    Set before running to skip prompts:    $env:M1_SEED  = "42"    $env:M1_SPEED = "1"    # 1=fast(0.4x), 2=normal(1.4x)    $env:M1_SCALE = "1"    # 1=small(5-7), 2=medium(8-10), 3=large(11-14)    $env:M1_DATE  = "2026-06-29"#>Set-StrictMode -Off$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"# -- Paths ----------------------------------------------------------------$ScriptDir  = Split-Path -Parent $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path$ToolsDir   = Join-Path $ScriptDir "tools"$ScriptsDir = Join-Path $ScriptDir "scripts"$DocsDir    = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents"$TmpDir     = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "chrome-profiles"# -- Find executables -----------------------------------------------------function Find-Exe {    param([string[]]$Candidates, [string]$Name)    foreach ($c in $Candidates) {        if (Test-Path $c) { return $c }    }    $cmd = Get-Command $Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue    if ($cmd) { return $cmd.Source }    return $null}$PythonExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\WINDOWS\py.exe",    "C:\Python314\python.exe",    "C:\Python312\python.exe",    "C:\Python311\python.exe",    "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\Python\Python312\python.exe") "python"$ChromeExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Google\Chrome\Application\chrome.exe") "chrome"$ExcelExe = Find-Exe @(    "C:\Program Files\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE",    "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Office\root\Office16\EXCEL.EXE") "EXCEL"# -- Quick validation before prompting ------------------------------------if (-not $PythonExe) { Write-Error "Python not found."; exit 1 }if (-not $ChromeExe) { Write-Error "Chrome not found."; exit 1 }# ============================================================================# 1. USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup --------------------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Cleaning up all launched processes..."# Kill all Chrome and desktop app processes we launchedforeach ($proc in $launched_procs) {    try {        if (-not $proc.HasExited) {            Stop-Process -Id $proc.Id -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue            Write-Host "    Killed PID $($proc.Id)"        }    } catch {}}# Kill http.server processes by port (in case -PassThru missed them)foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction USER INPUT  (prompt first, before any windows)# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host ("=" * 60)Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Run Setup"Write-Host ("=" * 60)# Seed — generate random if blank so orchestrator never re-promptsif (-not $env:M1_SEED) {    Write-Host "  [1] Seed - integer, blank for random" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SEED = Get-Random -Min 100000 -Max 999999 }}Write-Host "  [1] Seed: $env:M1_SEED"# Speedif (-not $env:M1_SPEED) {    Write-Host "  [2] Speed - 1=fast 0.4x  2=normal 1.4x  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SPEED = $raw } else { $env:M1_SPEED = "2" }}Write-Host "  [2] Speed: $env:M1_SPEED"# Scaleif (-not $env:M1_SCALE) {    Write-Host "  [3] Scale - 1=small 5-7  2=medium 8-10  3=large 11-14  [2]" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_SCALE = $raw } else { $env:M1_SCALE = "2" }}Write-Host "  [3] Scale: $env:M1_SCALE"# Dateif (-not $env:M1_DATE) {    Write-Host "  [4] Run date YYYY-MM-DD, blank=today" -NoNewline    $raw = Read-Host    if ($raw) { $env:M1_DATE = $raw } else { $env:M1_DATE = (Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd") }}Write-Host "  [4] Date: $env:M1_DATE"$env:PYTHONUTF8 = "1"Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Starting in 5 seconds. Press Ctrl-C to abort."Start-Sleep -Seconds 5# ============================================================================# 2. Infrastructure setup# ============================================================================Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 - Launch Checklist"Write-Host "  -------------------------------------------------------"Write-Host "  Python : $PythonExe"Write-Host "  Chrome : $ChromeExe"& $PythonExe -c "import pyautogui, websocket" 2>&1 | Out-Nullif ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {    Write-Warning "Some packages missing. Run: pip install pyautogui websocket-client"} else {    Write-Host "  packages OK"}# -- GT log dir -----------------------------------------------------------$GtLogDir = Join-Path (Split-Path $ScriptDir -Parent) "gt-logs"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $GtLogDir | Out-Null$RunId = "theme_m1_$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss')"Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"if (-not (Test-Path $DocsDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $DocsDir | Out-Null }$PdfCount = (Get-ChildItem $DocsDir -Filter "*.pdf" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).CountWrite-Host "  Docs   : $DocsDir ($PdfCount PDFs)"New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $TmpDir | Out-Null# -- Kill lingering http.server on our ports ------------------------------foreach ($port in @(5122, 5123, 5124)) {    $pids_raw = netstat -ano 2>$null | Select-String ":$port\s"    foreach ($line in $pids_raw) {        $p = ($line -split "\s+")[-1]        if ($p -match "^\d+$") {            try { Stop-Process -Id ([int]$p) -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}# -- Launch everything in parallel -----------------------------------------$launch_ops = @()# http.server for each portalWrite-Host "  Starting Python http.server on ports 5122/5123/5124..."$server_defs = @(    @{port=5122; dir="hr-portal-jp"},    @{port=5123; dir="finance-portal-jp"},    @{port=5124; dir="ops-portal-jp"})foreach ($entry in $server_defs) {    $d = Join-Path $ToolsDir $entry.dir    $launch_ops += @{exe=$PythonExe; args=@("-m", "http.server", "$($entry.port)", "--directory", $d); label="http.server :$($entry.port)"; hidden=$true}}# Notepad$launch_ops += @{exe="notepad.exe"; args=@(); label="Notepad"}# Excelif ($ExcelExe -and (Test-Path $ExcelExe)) {    $xlsRef = Join-Path $ScriptDir "documents\m1_reference.xlsx"    if (Test-Path $xlsRef) {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@("`"$xlsRef`""); label="Excel (m1_reference.xlsx)"}    } else {        $launch_ops += @{exe=$ExcelExe; args=@(); label="Excel"}    }} else {    Write-Warning "  Excel not found - lookup steps will be skipped"}# Browser extension — loaded into scripted Chrome so browser_* / URL / DOM events# appear in raw UIA stream. Override with $env:M1_EXT_PATH if needed.$ExtPath = if ($env:M1_EXT_PATH) { $env:M1_EXT_PATH } else {    Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE "Downloads\procmine-extension-v1.0.0 (1)\procmine-extension"}if (Test-Path $ExtPath) {    Write-Host "  Browser extension: $ExtPath"    Write-Host "  -> browser_url_change / DOM events WILL appear in raw stream"} else {    Write-Warning "  Browser extension not found at: $ExtPath"    Write-Warning "  Set M1_EXT_PATH to override. Raw stream will lack URL route context."    $ExtPath = $null}# 3 Chrome portal windows$portals = @(    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5122/"; cdp=9222; label="HR Portal";      dir="m1-hr"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5123/"; cdp=9223; label="Finance Portal";  dir="m1-finance"},    @{url="http://127.0.0.1:5124/"; cdp=9224; label="Ops Portal";      dir="m1-ops"})foreach ($p in $portals) {    $udd = Join-Path $TmpDir $p.dir    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $udd | Out-Null    $chromeArgs = @(        "--remote-debugging-port=$($p.cdp)",        "--user-data-dir=$udd",        "--no-first-run",        "--no-default-browser-check",        "--disable-features=TranslateUI",        "--remote-allow-origins=*",        "--window-size=1280,900",        "--new-window",        $p.url    )    if ($ExtPath) { $chromeArgs += "--load-extension=$ExtPath" }    $launch_ops += @{exe=$ChromeExe; args=$chromeArgs; label="Chrome $($p.label)"}}# Fire everything in parallel; keep handles for cleanup$launched_procs = @()foreach ($op in $launch_ops) {    Write-Host "    Launching $($op.label)..."    $spArgs = @{FilePath=$op.exe; PassThru=$true}    if ($op.args.Count -gt 0) { $spArgs.ArgumentList = $op.args }    if ($op.hidden) { $spArgs.WindowStyle = "Hidden" }    $proc = Start-Process @spArgs    if ($proc) { $launched_procs += $proc }}Write-Host "  Waiting for all windows and portals to load..."Start-Sleep -Seconds 8# -- Extension check -------------------------------------------------------# Load Unpacked extensions are stored in Secure Preferences (not Extensions folder)$ExtId = "gfnbggcmaifligdcdiafmlbgpogheenn"$ExtInstalled = $falseforeach ($dir in @("m1-hr", "m1-finance", "m1-ops")) {    $secPref = Join-Path $TmpDir "$dir\Default\Secure Preferences"    if (Test-Path $secPref) {        $txt = Get-Content $secPref -Raw        if ($txt -match $ExtId) { $ExtInstalled = $true; break }    }}$NmhRunning = $null -ne (Get-Process procmine-nmh -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)if ($ExtInstalled -and $NmhRunning) {    Write-Host "  [OK] Extension loaded + NMH connected -> browser_* events WILL be captured"} elseif ($ExtInstalled -and -not $NmhRunning) {    Write-Warning "  Extension installed but NMH (procmine-nmh.exe) not running. Check desktop agent is recording."} elseif (-not $ExtInstalled) {    Write-Warning "  Extension not found in profiles. Run one-time setup: open each portal in Chrome, go to chrome://extensions, Load unpacked -> $ExtPath"}# -- Run orchestrator -----------------------------------------------------Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Running orchestrator_m1.py  (Theme M1 - Mixed Multi-Domain)..."Write-Host "  -----------------------------------------------------------------"$OrchestratorPy = Join-Path $ScriptsDir "orchestrator_m1.py"Push-Location $ScriptsDir$exit_code = 0try {    $orchestrator_args = @(        $OrchestratorPy,        "--gt-run-id", "$RunId",        "--gt-log-dir", "$GtLogDir",        "--seed",  "$env:M1_SEED",        "--speed", "$env:M1_SPEED",        "--scale", "$env:M1_SCALE",        "--date",  "$env:M1_DATE"    )    & $PythonExe $orchestrator_args    $exit_code = $LASTEXITCODE} finally {    Pop-Location}# -- Audible done notification (recording runs unattended) ----------------try {    if ($exit_code -eq 0) {        [console]::beep(880, 250)        [console]::beep(1320, 350)    } else {        [console]::beep(440, 250)        [console]::beep(330, 400)    }} catch {}# -- Cleanup SilentlyContinue } catch {}        }    }}Write-Host ""Write-Host "  Theme M1 complete."Write-Host "  GT log : $GtLogDir\$RunId.jsonl"Write-Host ""if ($exit_code -ne 0) { exit $exit_code
